metadata.title: Credential and key stores review
metadata.description: Review known locations of SSH, GnuPG, cloud CLI and password-store secrets. Keys and tokens cannot be regenerated from files; nothing here is disposable.

insights.title: Review SSH keys and config
insights.subject: key store
insights.detail: Private keys here cannot be regenerated, and losing them locks you out of servers. Back up before changing anything. Check config and known_hosts before removing any entry.

insights.title: Review GnuPG keyring
insights.subject: key store
insights.detail: Holds private keys and the trust database. Export and back up keys with gpg before any change; deleting this folder can destroy keys you cannot restore.

insights.title: Review AWS CLI credentials
insights.subject: credentials
insights.detail: Access keys and profiles for the AWS CLI. Rotate or revoke keys in the AWS console when they are no longer needed; use the aws configure tools for changes.

insights.title: Review kubeconfig
insights.subject: credentials
insights.detail: Cluster endpoints and credentials, and possibly cloud CLI plugin references. Keep a copy before editing; use kubectl config commands for changes.

insights.title: Review Docker CLI config
insights.subject: credentials
insights.detail: Docker CLI settings. config.json may hold registry login data. Use docker logout to remove a login, and back up contexts you still need.

insights.title: Review Azure CLI profile
insights.subject: credentials
insights.detail: Azure CLI sign-in data and cached tokens. Use the az account and az logout commands for changes; removing this folder signs you out.

insights.title: Review pass password store
insights.subject: password store
insights.detail: Encrypted entries of the pass password manager. Entries cannot be read without the GPG key, so back up the folder and its keys together.
